scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @contract-ripple/shared && npm run build -w @contract-ripple/engine && npm run build -w @contract-ripple/source-analysis && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @contract-ripple/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @contract-ripple/shared && npm run build -w @contract-ripple/engine && npm run build -w @contract-ripple/source-analysis && npm run build -w @contract-ripple/api
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:api
scripts.api:dev: npm run build:shared && npm run build:engine && npm run build:source && npm run dev -w @contract-ripple/api
